insights.text: Oh lord, so I just found out by accident you can skip the first 2 areas entirely  by walking to the western part of the area Zilyana is in... like the whole ⅓ to the west. I was running around looking for things I may have missed and the checkpoint unlocked thing popped up. Sure enough, you can go to the stronghold, then walk past the blue thing foe the next, portal to Zil, then do the little jump course for the 4th. Its a few minutes faster than this video even... they really didnt thoroughly test this stuff.
